note: Chapter 4, South Branch (Konrad) – the data station: side task “Planspiel Abgang”, the mini-game “The Data Station” (login, list / open / search, release) and the mini-game “Planspiel Abgang” (a wireframe on the display unit). English twin of de_terminal.json: same keys, same placeholders, the machine's files with the same number of lines (at most 46 characters each). Program name, case numbers (S8-…) and the operator number stay as in German.

strings.explore.berlin.annex.term_desk.title: The data station
strings.explore.berlin.annex.term_desk.text: Between the machine room and the index stands a grey desk: a round display unit, a teleprinter, a tape cabinet, a card reader. On the plate: “Data Station South – household index entry”. The sliding ladder no longer gets past it. Whoever works here climbs to no drawer any more. On the screen stands one line, green and patient: “OPERATOR NO.?” It will not mean my service number.
strings.explore.berlin.annex.term_roster.title: Duty roster of the data station
strings.explore.berlin.annex.term_roster.text: Beside the ladder hangs a clipboard: “Duty roster, data station, week 8”. Sunday: “no shift – ventilation maintenance”. Tuesday, late shift until 24:00: “Kunze, E., operator no. 2741 – handover Kordon”. Next to it someone has drawn a small cake in pencil. On Tuesday it is her birthday, and at 23:40 she hands over the cards. Two, seven, four, one. I make a note of her number.
strings.explore.berlin.annex.term_files.title: Wendt’s memo
strings.explore.berlin.annex.term_files.prompt: Log in at the data station
strings.explore.berlin.annex.term_files.text: The machine takes Fräulein Kunze’s number and does not ask who is entering it. The transfer list C-17/45 holds the households from Süd 8; Wendt’s memo says what is to be rehearsed before Tuesday: the arrest of a child nobody has reported. Case S8-067, Lindner, releases the program. It is called “Planspiel Abgang” – the departure exercise. The operator’s log shows eleven runs and eleven times “arrest”. Below them now stands my login, under her number.
strings.explore.berlin.annex.planspiel.title: Run twelve
strings.explore.berlin.annex.planspiel.text: The teleprinter hammers the result onto the strip: “Situation 3, run 12: ABGANG. Route: passage – yard – stairwell – attic – fire wall.” Eleven times the machine caught the child. The twelfth time I did the running. It knows the breach in the fire wall from our plans; nobody assigned a post to it. I tear off the strip and pocket it. Now I know the way. They do not know it yet.
strings.task.berlin.planspiel.title: Planspiel Abgang
strings.task.berlin.planspiel.summary: Between the machine room and the index stands a data station. It asks for an operator number, and on one of its tapes lies a program the State Police ordered.
strings.task.berlin.planspiel.hint.desk: Look at the grey desk between the machine room and the index.
strings.task.berlin.planspiel.hint.roster: The machine wants an operator number. Somewhere in the hall hangs the duty roster of the data station.
strings.task.berlin.planspiel.hint.files: Log in at the desk with Fräulein Kunze’s number and read what the machine knows about Süd 8.
strings.task.berlin.planspiel.hint.run: The program is released. Start “Planspiel Abgang” at the desk.

strings.mg.term.status.login: The machine is waiting for an operator number.
strings.mg.term.status.idle: List, open, search. The program “Abgang” is locked.
strings.mg.term.status.menu: Logged in as operator 2741. The operator’s log says so too, now.
strings.mg.term.status.refused: “Number unknown.” The machine does not take just any.
strings.mg.term.status.release_fail: “Release refused.” This household is fully recorded.
strings.mg.term.status.release_unknown: The machine has not loaded any case numbers yet. They are in the list C-17/45.
strings.mg.term.status.restart: Logged out. The machine asks for the number again.
strings.mg.term.solved: Case S8-067, Lindner. The machine releases the program; in the tape cabinet, tape 7 starts up.
strings.mg.term.hint.login.1: Hint: The number is on the duty roster of the data station. It hangs beside the second ladder, under the ventilation plan.
strings.mg.term.hint.login.2: Hint: Fräulein Kunze’s operator number is 2741.
strings.mg.term.hint.release.1: Hint: Wendt’s memo says which household is meant: the one whose whereabouts are open. Its case number is in the list C-17/45.
strings.mg.term.hint.release.2: Hint: The open household is Lindner, case S8-067. Open the program “Abgang” and choose that number.
strings.mg.abgang.title: Planspiel Abgang
strings.mg.abgang.subtitle: Tape 7, situation 3: a child, alone, who knows the quarter. The machine sets the posts. I run for the child.
strings.mg.abgang.instruction: Lead the bright figure to the gap. A post sees the hatched cells. Walls, bins and chimneys give cover. Whoever is seen starts the map again.
strings.mg.abgang.goal.attic: the breach in the fire wall
strings.mg.abgang.hud.title: PLANSPIEL ABGANG · SITUATION 3
strings.mg.abgang.status.start: Situation 3, run 12. The posts walk to the beat.
strings.mg.abgang.status.seen: Post {p} has seen the child. The machine reports “arrest” and sets the map up again.
strings.mg.abgang.status.through: Through. The machine loads the next map.
strings.mg.abgang.status.restart: The map starts again. The posts are back on beat one.
strings.mg.abgang.solved: Situation 3, run 12: Abgang. At the desk the teleprinter starts up.
strings.mg.abgang.hint.street: Hint: The post on the roadway only looks ahead. Cross the street behind his back. Before the passage, wait until the second post looks south.
strings.mg.abgang.hint.yard: Hint: The post in the middle of the yard turns on every two beats. Run through the field he is just turning away from. Sheds and bins give cover.
strings.mg.abgang.hint.attic: Hint: At the foot of the stairs the post on the landing cannot see you. Go up behind him. In the attic the chimneys give cover: let the second post walk past you.
strings.mg.abgang.hint.trace: Hint: The display draws a trace. While it is dim, wait. When it turns bright, run.
